front.title: Task and Evidence Information Model for AINETOps

abstract.t: As Network Management Agents (NMAs) increasingly collaborate in scenarios such as fault diagnosis, network optimization, and service assurance, consistent task descriptions and evidence information are needed across vendors and management domains. This document defines a Task and Evidence Information Model for AI-Enabled Network Operations (AINETOps). The model consists of Task Core, Evidence Core, and a Profile extension mechanism for different task and evidence types. This document does not specify communication protocols, request or response formats, task execution methods, or network configuration operations.
